replacements.Por qué la eficiencia no reduce el consu: Why efficiency does not reduce consumption: the rebound effect
replacements.Cuando una tecnología se vuelve más efic: When a technology becomes more efficient, its unit cost falls. But that encourages more use, more use cases and more powerful models. The net result can be higher total consumption, not lower consumption.
replacements.Cada operación consume menos energía. Me: Each operation consumes less energy. Less heat, lower cooling costs and higher compute density per rack.
replacements.Servir un modelo se vuelve más barato. A: Serving a model becomes cheaper. Applications that were previously economically unviable cross the profitability threshold.
replacements.Más sectores y geografías pueden despleg: More sectors and geographies can deploy AI. More specialized models. More simultaneous users.
replacements.El volumen de uso crece más rápido que l: Usage volume grows faster than efficiency improves. Aggregate energy consumption rises even though each operation consumes less.
replacements.Este patrón tiene nombre: paradoja de Je: This pattern has a name: the Jevons paradox (1865). Formulated for coal, later applied to oil and now observable in semiconductors. Data-center electricity consumption grew steadily during the same years in which efficiency per operation also improved steadily. Both trends are true at the same time.
